value: mixed frame rates within one image
note: Spider-Verse abandons a single consistent frame rate — 24fps for some elements, 12fps animated on twos for others. Spider-Punk carries different rates for different parts of his body and his guitar. Imageworks built StepSets to republish scenes at different rates and generate sims accordingly.

value: line and dot as light and shadow
note: A deliberate style language where light and reflections are defined by dots and shadows by lines — hatching rather than shading. The first CG animated feature with a dedicated inking team.
